title: Settings
autoShutdownDesc: Automatically stop containers after idle timeout
batchDrainDesc: Drain queue items in batches for efficiency
lazyStopDesc: Wait for in-flight requests before stopping
parallelSlotSkipDesc: Skip busy parallel slots and defer requests to later slots
conversationAffinityDesc: Keep a model's runtime reserved while an agent/tool-call conversation is actively using it, preventing model-switch thrash between tool calls
enableBenchmarkingDesc: Auto-run the default benchmark when a model is registered
conversationHoldDesc: How long a conversation keeps its runtime reserved after its last request (minimum 1)
queueStepsResetDesc: How many queue items are processed before the parallel-slot skip counter resets
maxWaitTime: Max wait time for a runtime to become healthy (10–600s)
maxWaitTimeHint: Value will be clamped to 10–600 on save
retryAttemptsDesc: Number of retry attempts per model on server error (0–10)
retryDelayDesc: Delay between retry attempts in milliseconds (0–30000)
retryDelayHint: Value will be clamped to 0–30000 on save
retryHint: Value will be clamped to 0–10 on save
serverErrorRetryDesc: When a cloud provider returns a 5xx server error, retry the same model before falling back to the next one in the profile.
metricsPollIntervalDesc: How often to fetch live GPU/CPU/RAM metrics when agents are expanded
